articles.title: 'Endgame: Encore' advance bookings cross Rs 13 crore in India
articles.summary: Avengers Endgame: Encore is set to re-release on Friday, September 25, amidst strong advance bookings in India. The film has recorded an estimated Rs 13.23 crore in advance sales, with Rs 5.05 crore grossed on opening day.

articles.title: Sam Smith and Normani’s plea to drop the ‘Dancing with a Stranger’ lawsuit rejected
articles.summary: The hit collaboration between Sam Smith and Normani, 'Dancing with a Stranger', is entangled in a renewed legal battle as the previous dismissal of a lawsuit has been overturned. A federal judge has decided that the case merits a jury trial to examine the aspects of originality in the song’s composition.

articles.title: Hayley Williams talks about her ex, Chad Gilbert
articles.summary: In a heartfelt tribute, Hayley Williams reminisced about her almost decade-long relationship with Chad Gilbert, who recently succumbed to brain cancer. Williams conveyed deep appreciation for the musical journey they embarked on together and the cultural influence he had on her life.
